landing.subtitle: oikui helps you analyze Telegram and YouTube comments, detect toxic speech, and visualize trends in a professional dashboard built for modern AI-driven decision making.

deep.title: Deep AI Analysis
deep.description: Understand sentiment, context, and intent using advanced batch AI scoring built for large comment volumes.

cross.title: Cross-Platform (Telegram & YouTube)

charts.description: Track sentiment shifts with dynamic timeline charts and visual dashboards tailored for product teams.

toxic.title: Toxic Speech Detection
toxic.description: Identify harmful and high-risk comments early with dedicated toxicity scoring and moderation insights.
